title: onPaste handlers on the operator <select> elements never fire (paste is not dispatched on <select>)
description: The lower/upper operator cells render `<select ... onPaste={(e) => handleCellPaste(e, i, 0|2)}>`. Native HTML <select> elements do not receive `paste` events in Chrome/Firefox/Safari (paste only targets editable text controls), so these two handlers are effectively dead and there is no way to range-paste starting from an operator column via the cell path. The whole-grid container paste (`handlePaste`) still covers operator data because it parses full rows, so functionality is not lost — the cell-level handlers on selects are simply unreachable code carrying the `fieldIndex` 0/2 mapping for op columns.
evidence: Line 304: `<select value={rule.op1 || ''} ... onPaste={(e) => handleCellPaste(e, i, 0)}>`; line 321: same for op2 with fieldIndex 2. handleCellPaste relies on a `paste` event that <select> never emits. Compare TwoWayGrid.tsx where onPaste is only attached to <input> cells (lines 250, 321), not selects.
